title: Merkaba Time Machine: Counter-Rotating Tetrahedra as Temporal Generator
description: Model where two counter-rotating tetrahedra create a temporal gradient. Upper: v = φ·c → γ → ∞ (outside time). Lower: v = (1/φ)·c → γ ≈ 1.272 (in time). Cell born at temporal boundary between two times, carrying relativistic γ factor from birth moment. Three modes: symmetric, asymmetric (φ-limit), light.
